subject: how to get one column lods score for multiple phenotypes?

messages.author: 3c4c92d6189c248d
messages.subject: how to get one column lods score for multiple phenotypes?
parts:
say I have 36 phenotypes, all of which are about blood pressure. I
want to do sth, like integrating all phenotypes into one to map the
genetic factors contributing to blood pressure.

Is there anyway to do that in R/qtl? Or I have to run PCA to extract
some abstract phenotypes and then run r/qtl on PCA?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how to get one column lods score for multiple phenotypes?
parts:
R/qtl doesn't currently include any facilities for the joint analysis of multiple phenotypes. It just maps them one at a time.

karl
